"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA asks its locals and activists to insist on the inclusion of a strong public component in any health-care reform legislation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2,5]},{"claim_text":"DSA asks its locals and activists to insist on the inclusion of a state opt-out so that individual states can enact their own single-payer plans.",
